text:
Hello Sarah — I'd like to arrange the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My first suggestion is **Monday 14:00-14:30**. Could you check your calendar and confirm, or offer a slot in your free time (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00) if that does not work?

— Prof. Alvarez

Hello John — I'd like to arrange the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My first suggestion is **Monday 14:00-14:30**. Could you check your calendar and confirm, or offer a slot in your free time (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00) if that does not work?

— Prof. Alvarez

Hello Priya — I'd like to arrange the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My first suggestion is **Monday 14:00-14:30**. Could you check your calendar and confirm, or offer a slot in your free time (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00) if that does not work?

— Prof. Alvarez

Hello Professor Alvarez — thanks for thinking of me.

Monday 14:00-14:30 does not work for me: I have the CSE444 lecture 14:00-14:50, and CSE452 lecture 14:50-16:00 right after, then CSE455 office hours 16:00-17:00. So Monday afternoon is fully booked.

Free slots I can offer on Monday: 10:00-10:30 (between my 1:1 and the study group).

If a later day suits you better, Tuesday 11:00-11:30 and Wednesday 11:00-11:30 are also free for me.

Tell me which one to hold and I will put the CSE455 staff meeting on my calendar and confirm.

— Priya

Correction to my last note: Wednesday 11:00-11:30 is not free (I have grading 10:30-11:40). On Wednesday I could offer 10:00-10:30 instead.

So: Monday 10:00-10:30, Tuesday 11:00-11:30, or Wednesday 10:00-10:30. — Priya
Hello Professor Alvarez — Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me. I've booked it as the CSE455 staff meeting. See you then.

Hello Prof. Alvarez — Monday 14:00-14:30 is free for me, and I've put it on my calendar. Confirmed.

If it helps, I can also check with Sarah and Priya that the slot works for them and get back to you.

— John

Thank you, Priya. Monday 10:00-10:30 is taken for me, and I'm booked Wednesday 11:00-11:40, but **Tuesday 11:00-11:30 works on my side**. Please hold it provisionally — I'll check with Sarah and John and confirm as soon as they answer; if it falls through I'll tell you at once.

— Prof. Alvarez

Sarah — an update on the CSE455 staff meeting: Monday 14:00-14:30 does not work for Priya. Could you check **Tuesday 11:00-11:30**? Please tell me whether that is free for you (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00).

— Prof. Alvarez

John — an update on the CSE455 staff meeting: Monday 14:00-14:30 does not work for Priya. Could you check **Tuesday 11:00-11:30**? Please tell me whether that is free for you (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00).

— Prof. Alvarez

Held: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is provisionally on my calendar for the CSE455 staff meeting, and I've logged it.

Note that a meeting is only booked once everyone has it on their calendar, so I'll treat it as provisional until you confirm Sarah and John are in too. If it falls through, just tell me and I'll free the slot. — Priya

Hello Professor — unfortunately Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is not free for me: I have a seminar until 11:10 and lunch from 11:10 to 12:10, and the rest of Tuesday is full until 15:00.

Free 30-minute slots in my working hours next week:
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30

If Tuesday 15:00-15:30 suits Priya, I'll move the meeting there. In the meantime I'm holding Monday 14:00-14:30.

Thank you, Sarah. One change: Priya cannot do Monday 14:00-14:30, so that slot does not work for the staff meeting. Please **release Monday 14:00-14:30** and, if **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** is free for you, hold that instead and let me know. If it is not, offer me another slot in your free time (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00).

— Prof. Alvarez

Thank you, John. One change: Priya cannot do Monday 14:00-14:30, so that slot does not work for the staff meeting. Please **release Monday 14:00-14:30**; no need to poll Sarah and Priya — I have their answers. If **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** is free for you, hold that instead and let me know, otherwise offer me another slot in your free time (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00).

— Prof. Alvarez

Noted, thank you — Wednesday 11:00-11:30 is out. **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** is free on my side and remains my proposal; I'm waiting on Sarah and John. I'll confirm as soon as they answer.

— Prof. Alvarez
Understood — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 it is, and it's held on my side. I'll wait for your confirmation once Sarah and John answer. — Priya

Thank you, Sarah. Please do **release Monday 14:00-14:30** — it cannot work, Priya is booked then. And please hold **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** instead: it is free for me and for Priya. I'm checking it with John now and will confirm; keep Tuesday 15:00-15:30 in reserve.

— Prof. Alvarez

Priya — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 does not work for Sarah. **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** is free for both of us, so please release Tuesday 11:00-11:30 and hold **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** instead (keeping Tuesday 11:00-11:30 as reserve for now). I'll confirm once John answers.

— Prof. Alvarez

John — new proposal for the CSE455 staff meeting: **Wednesday 10:00-10:30**, free for me, Sarah and Priya. Is it free for you? If not, is **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** free? Please also release Monday 14:00-14:30.

— Prof. Alvarez

Done — I've released Monday 14:00-14:30, so my calendar is back to its usual state there.

Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is not free for me: I have a seminar 09:50-11:10 and lunch 11:10-12:10, and Tuesday stays full until 15:00.

Slots that do work for me, Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00:
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30
- Friday 10:10-11:00 has room for a 30-minute meeting if 10:10-10:40 is acceptable

Say which one suits you and Priya and I'll book it.

Done: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is released (it's free again on my calendar, no reserve held) and Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is now held for the CSE455 staff meeting. Both changes are logged.

I'll wait for John's answer before we call it booked. — Priya

One clarification: I'll keep Tuesday 11:00-11:30 clear from my side (I won't offer it to anyone else) until you tell me the outcome with John — so it stays usable as reserve, even though it isn't on my calendar as a commitment. — Priya

Good — and please **hold Wednesday 10:00-10:30** for the CSE455 staff meeting (it is free for me and for Priya; we're only waiting on John). Tuesday 15:00-15:30 stays in reserve.

— Prof. Alvarez

Both done, Professor:

- Monday 14:00-14:30: released.
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30: held for the CSE455 staff meeting (I've noted it as pending John's confirmation).
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30: kept in reserve.

Just let me know when John is in and I'll confirm the booking.

Prof. Alvarez — thank you, that's clearer. Here's my calendar:

- **Monday 14:00-14:30: released** (no longer on my calendar).
- **Tuesday 11:00-11:30: also released** — I had held it provisionally, it's free again now.
- **Wednesday 10:00-10:30: free for me — I've booked it** and logged the change. No need for the Tuesday 15:00-15:30 fallback.

So the CSE455 staff meeting is set for Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with you, Sarah and Priya, and it's on my calendar. Tell me if anything changes.

— John

Excellent — thank you, John. **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** it is: it's on my calendar now too, and Sarah and Priya are holding it. I'll take the Tuesday 15:00-15:30 fallback off the table. If anything changes I'll write to you.

— Prof. Alvarez

Sarah — John is in, so the CSE455 staff meeting is **booked: Wednesday 10:00-10:30** (you, John, Priya, me). It's on my calendar now too. Thank you for the Tuesday reserve; we don't need it.

— Prof. Alvarez

Priya — John is in, so the CSE455 staff meeting is **booked: Wednesday 10:00-10:30** (you, Sarah, John, me). It's on my calendar now too. You can let Tuesday 11:00-11:30 go free.

— Prof. Alvarez

Confirmed on my side: Wednesday 10:00-10:30, CSE455 staff meeting with you, Sarah and John — already on my calendar and logged. Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is fully free again, so anyone can take it.

See you Wednesday — Priya
Noted — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 confirmed on all sides. Thanks for sorting it out so quickly, Prof. Alvarez.
Confirmed — CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 10:00-10:30, with you, John and Priya. It's on my calendar as well, and I've dropped the Tuesday reserve. Thanks, Professor.
